Frequently Asked Questions

How do I scan my fridge?

Tap the Scan My Fridge button on the home screen. You can use your camera or upload a photo from your photo library. The AI will detect ingredients and suggest recipes.

How many free scans do I get?

New users receive 1 free scan. After that, you can unlock unlimited scans by purchasing the Premium plan.

How do I get unlimited scans?

When your free scan is used, a paywall screen will appear offering the Premium plan (£4.99 one-time purchase) for unlimited scans. Tap Unlock Premium to purchase.

How do I restore my purchase?

Go to Settings → Restore Purchases inside the app and tap the Restore button.

How do I delete my account?

Go to Settings → Delete Account. This permanently deletes your account and all associated data.

Do I need an account to use the app?

No — you can scan your fridge and get recipe suggestions without creating an account. An account is only needed to save favourite recipes across devices.
